rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: CHAP. LIV. Of Buying and Selling Commodities.
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Chapter LIV begins below the printed divider following Chapter LIII.

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: The Buyer is signified by the Lord of the ascendant and the Moon
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Lilly assigns the buyer to the ascendant lord AND Moon in this buying/selling question.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: source-defined buyer: Lord of first + Moon

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: the Seller by the Lord of the seventh
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Lilly assigns the seller to the seventh-house lord.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: source-defined seller: Lord of seventh

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Moon be joyned with the Lord of the seventh
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: A Moon/seventh-lord conjunction is given as a testimony that the querent may buy the desired commodity quickly.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: Moon conjunct seventh lord

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Lord of the ascendant be a more light Planet then the Lord of the seventh
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: A lighter first-house lord than seventh-house lord is said to give the querent the initiative in occasioning the sale.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: first lord lighter than seventh lord

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: & e contra, if the Lord of the seventh be the lighter Planet
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: The text gives a converse for a lighter seventh-house lord, without an independently enumerated full inverse algorithm.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: seventh lord lighter than first lord; do not infer numeric strengths or timing

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: preceding Significators have no aspect ... Moon or some other Planet transferre ... light
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: If the preceding significators lack an aspect but the Moon or another planet transfers light between them, an intermediary is predicted.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: NO direct aspect AND translation of light via Moon OR another planet

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: a Friend shall then appear ... drive on the bargaine for them both
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: The intermediary in the immediately preceding light-translation condition is said to bring the bargain to completion for both parties.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: depends on condition of C007; not independent testimony

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Servant or Sheep, Hogges, Coneys ... the sixt house and his Lord
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: For servants or sheep, pigs, rabbits and similar goods, consult the sixth house and its lord.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: commodity is servant OR sheep OR hog OR rabbit etc.

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Horses, Asses, Camels, Oxen or Cowes ... twelfth house and the ascendant
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: For horses, asses, camels, oxen or cows, Lilly assigns the twelfth house and ascendant.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: commodity is horse OR ass OR camel OR ox OR cow

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: House, Towne or Castle ... fourth house and his Lord
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: For houses, towns or castles, consult the fourth house and its lord.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: commodity is house OR town OR castle

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: and so consider in any other Commodity
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: The author tells the reader to adapt house-signification to other commodities; no complete commodity list or general exhaustive classifier is supplied.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: open-ended authorial instruction; no added associations

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Lord of the seventh be in the ascendant ... Seller will importune
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Seventh lord in the ascendant is said to mean the seller presses the querent to buy.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: seventh-house lord located in the first

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Lord of the ascendant be in the seventh ... querent hath most mind to buy
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: First lord in the seventh is said to show the querent most inclined to buy.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: first-house lord located in seventh; not same as C013

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: either Jupiter or Venus be in the ascendant ... Buyer performes ... suddenly
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Either Jupiter OR Venus in the ascendant is said to permit sudden buyer completion without labor.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: Jupiter OR Venus in first house

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: so if the Sun be in the ascendant and not corporally joyned
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Sun in ascendant is offered as an alternative quick-buyer condition only when NOT corporally conjunct another planet.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: Sun first AND not corporally conjunct any other planet

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Mercury or Moon in ascendant, not infected ... evill aspect of an Infortune
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Mercury OR Moon in the first, without an evil malefic aspect, is said to favor the buyer completing the intended bargain.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: Mercury OR Moon first AND no evil aspect from malefic

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Saturn Mars or node-like glyph in the ascendant ... labour and difficulty
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: The printed Saturn/Mars/node-like first-house condition predicts labor and difficulty, with its final words continuing on printed page 377.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: Saturn OR Mars OR printed node-like glyph in first; glyph interpretation retained

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Buyer is a cunning companion ... deceive the Seller if possible
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Following the first-house malefic condition, Lilly further claims the buyer will act deceitfully toward the seller; this is a historical allegation not evidence of any real buyer.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: depends on preceding malefic first-house premise C018

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Infortunes be in the seventh ... Seller ... delude the Buyer
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Malefics in seventh are said to warn of seller deception toward the buyer.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: malefic planet(s) located in seventh house

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Moon be voyd of course, unlesse the Significators apply strongly
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Moon void-of-course is said to hinder conclusion or purchase and produce pointless bargaining, unless the significators apply strongly.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: Moon VOC AND no strong significator application; the exception is essential

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Planet from whom the Moon separates enters Combustion
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: The author claims sellers of land or house will never recover the property if the planet Moon separated from enters combustion.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: sale of land OR house AND Moon previous separating planet enters combustion

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: Moon did last separate ... free from misfortune ... beholds the Lord of that Sign
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: If Moon last separated from a planet free of misfortune that beholds the relevant sign-lord, the author says the seller might later repurchase property or goods of equivalent value.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: Moon former separating planet free from misfortune AND beholds relevant sign lord; referent uncertain

rules.source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
rules.source_anchor_editorial_abbreviation: CHAP. LV. Of Partnership.
rules.source_statement_paraphrase: Chapter LIV ends immediately above the horizontal divider; the Chapter LV partnership heading appears below it, with its body excluded.
rules.source_predicates_and_qualifiers: navigation marker only; no Chapter LV claims
